gates.detail: 5/5 agree [mean_direction=254.32 vs ref 254.32; resultant_length=0.19528 vs ref 0.19528; mean_abs_diff=5.6843e-14 vs ref 0; rbar_abs_diff=0 vs ref 0; rbar_mean5=0.2093 vs ref 0.2093]
gates.citation: Fisher NI (1993). Statistical Analysis of Circular Data. CUP. Reference impl: the R `circular` package (Agostinelli & Lund). Vector coding: Needham et al. (2014). Data: WBDS (Fukuchi et al. 2018), knee-ankle gait coupling angles.

reference.citation: Fisher NI (1993). Statistical Analysis of Circular Data. CUP. Reference impl: the R `circular` package (Agostinelli & Lund). Vector coding: Needham et al. (2014). Data: WBDS (Fukuchi et al. 2018), knee-ankle gait coupling angles.
reference.description: re-computes the mean direction + mean resultant length with the canonical `circular` package (mean.circular, rho.circular) and compares to circularSummary's; reports the machine-precision agreement (R-bar |diff| = 0, mean |diff| ~ 6e-14), the Rayleigh p both ways (op 3.16e-8 vs circular 3.66e-8, both significant), and the 5-subject R-bar (mean 0.209, min 0.059)
